patterns: Direct single-fact items dominate: Fa-Hien's ruler (Chandragupta II), hospital at Pataliputra, Gupta gold coin = Dinara.
Ports are a favourite: Tamralipti for North Indian trade; Ghantasala, Kadura, Chaul = foreign-trade ports (Andhra tilt).
Guild questions use a 'NOT a feature' shape with 'non-autonomous bodies' as the trap.
Inscription identification (Dashpur = silk weavers' guild / first advertisement) recurs in state PSCs.
Post-Gupta decline of towns, feudalism and jajmani appear as single-fact or A/R items.
App leans to multi-statement items and fine detail (land-type matches, chronology of developments) beyond PYQ depth.
